friction_section.title: The Friction Point
friction_section.subtitle: Ladies hair salons manage constant appointment requests, repeat clients, styling consultations, last-minute cancellations, and manual follow-ups that slow down growth.

cards.title: Manual Booking Pressure
cards.description: Haircuts, blow dries, coloring, balayage, bridal styling, and treatment bookings often require repeated phone calls and manual scheduling.

cards.title: Disconnected Client Data
cards.description: Client preferences, appointment history, color notes, service interests, and follow-up reminders are often spread across separate tools.

cards.title: Missed Rebooking Opportunities
cards.description: Without automated reminders and client recall workflows, salons lose repeat bookings for color refreshes, trims, treatments, and special occasion styling.
